name: au-objections
description: Use this guide to prepare an objection to an ATO assessment or decision under Part IVC of the Taxation Administration Act 1953, on the law at 2 November 2026 (2026-27), for individuals, sole traders, companies, trusts, partnerships and super funds. Covers the objection right, section 14ZW periods by decision and taxpayer type, amended assessments, late objection requests under sections 14ZW and 14ZX, grounds and the burden of proof, disputed debts, and review by the Administrative Review Tribunal or appeal to the Federal Court. Trigger on 'objection', 'late objection', 'extension of time to object', 'Part IVC', 'ART review' or 'disputed debt'.
